_help: Business details used on every page. Edit here, run `python build.py`, then upload the public/ folder. Empty "" values are simply not shown on the site.
_help_mobile: Optional mobile number in +30... form. If filled, Viber and WhatsApp buttons appear on the contact page.
_help_email: The address must exist (create it in Hostinger hPanel > Emails). Website form messages are delivered here.
_help_geo: Optional exact coordinates of the mill, e.g. 38.6170 and 23.2330 (right-click the mill in Google Maps to copy them).

season._help: Shown in the top bar of every page. Set show to false to hide it.

text.el: Το ελαιοτριβείο λειτουργεί. Κλείστε σειρά τηλεφωνικά.
text.en: The mill is running. Call to book your slot.

hours._help_offseason: What happens February – September, e.g. "Κατόπιν τηλεφωνικής συνεννόησης". Leave empty to hide.

social._help: Full profile addresses, e.g. https://www.facebook.com/yourpage. Empty = icon not shown.

legal._help: Business identification shown in the footer and privacy policy (ask your accountant).

features._help: Set oil_page to true when you start selling bottled oil; the page then appears in the menu and in Google.
